cards.front: Define the canonical partition function $Z$ for a system with energies $E_i$.
State the fundamental relation between Helmholtz free energy $F$ and $Z$.
Derive the mean energy $\langle E \rangle$ from $Z$.
Obtain the entropy $S$ from $F$ (or equivalently from $Z$).
Derive $F=-k_B T\ln Z$ starting from $F=U-TS$ and the Boltzmann probabilities.
cards.back: Probabilities $p_i=Z^{-1}e^{-\beta E_i}$. Then $S=-k_B\sum p_i\ln p_i$ yields $S=k_B\beta U+k_B\ln Z$. Substituting into $F=U-TS$ gives $F=-k_B T\ln Z$.

cards.front: For two non-interacting subsystems, how do $Z$ and $F$ combine?
Express the pressure $P$ in terms of $Z$ (or $F$).

cards.back: $F\to E_0$ (ground-state energy), since only the lowest term survives in $Z$.
